name: Sqrxz 3
author: Retroguru
description_short: A demanding and almost impossible jump'n'run for hardcore gamers that needs fast fingers and a fast brain.
description_long: Sqrxz 3 - Adventure for Love brings a retro look straight from 1990 with 10 knotty levels, secrets to discover, 11 chiptunes, a top-ten high-score table and an infinite continue mode.
